title: Risk assessment and prediction of early blood transfusion after joint replacement surgery: a clinical decision support model based on machine learning.
summary: Random-forest, logistic and SVM models predict transfusion within 72 hours after arthroplasty using 1,954 patients and calibration/decision-curve analyses. The result is reported in BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: LASSO selected 15 predictors for logistic-regression, random-forest and support-vector-machine models that estimated transfusion risk within 72 hours after hip or knee arthroplasty.
